All intellectual property rights in the Deliverables belong to Client from the moment they are created during the project.
findings.explanation: This clause vests intellectual property rights in the client immediately upon creation, before you have received final payment, exposing you to non-payment risk while the client already owns the work.
findings.suggested_change: Propose that IP ownership transfers to the client only upon receipt of full payment for the applicable deliverables.

content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body: Hello, Thank you for sharing the agreement. I am looking forward to working together. Before signing, I would like to propose a small adjustment regarding the relevant clause: - Regarding the clause stating that intellectual property rights belong to the client upon creation, this means ownership transfers before final payment is received. I propose that intellectual property ownership transfers to the client only upon receipt of full payment for the applicable deliverables. Please let me know if this works for you. Best regards,
